execution: Local required cloud runner against actual Neon, not GitHub Actions
measurementBoundary: One coordinator monotonic clock brackets commit and observation. liveUpperMs includes commit acknowledgement; liveLowerMs starts after acknowledgement. finiteColdMs is the first request, not proof of provider process cold start.
comparisonLimitations: Same fixture, region, fixed 1 CU, client placement and workload. Retained baseline runs precede final native runs by several hours; runs are not contemporaneous or randomized. This is acceptance evidence for this workload, not a production SLA.
resourceInterpretation: Heap samples include repeated collection drops and a bounded observed envelope; quarter minima and full heap sample series are retained. Drained ownership counters are checked separately. These observations do not prove the absence of all leaks.
